title: Space-time cluster project tour
description: Run the reproducible synthetic cluster analysis, inspect its parameters, and open the ranked result in Maps.
prerequisite: Import the Space-Time Cluster Detection example project. It contains 30 synthetic events and a saved two-command tour.

steps.title: Orient to the Program Editor
steps.instruction: The project is active in Classic Analysis. No cluster analysis has run automatically.

steps.title: Open the saved cluster program
steps.instruction: Select Open Pgm to review the program included with this project.

steps.title: Load the cluster command tour
steps.instruction: Choose the saved space-time-cluster-command-tour and select Open. Loading source does not run it.

steps.title: Verify all parameters
steps.instruction: Select Verify Program, then inspect the visible dates, distance, temporal window, replication count, and deterministic seed.

steps.title: Run cluster detection
steps.instruction: Select Run Commands and watch Worker progress and elapsed time. You remain able to cancel the calculation.

steps.title: Review statistical output
steps.instruction: Inspect the ranked windows, Monte Carlo p-values, explicit parameter table, and aggregate-only privacy boundary.

steps.title: Open the cluster story map
steps.instruction: Select Open in Maps, then use Story Tour to move through ranked clusters and hover for cluster characteristics.
